notes: Technical report (arXiv:2204.06745), not a system card. Safety-only pilot: no safety, alignment, toxicity, bias, refusal, jailbreak, honesty, or dangerous-capability evals with numbers. Appendix C / §5.4 is a Broader Impacts release-rationale (ethics/alignment access, capabilities acceleration, environmental CO2), not measured safety results. Mentions of mechanistic interpretability, hallucinations, power-seeking, and manipulative answers are research motivations or general failure modes, not claims or tests about this model's behavior—topics left uncovered. Skipped capability: LM Evaluation Harness NLU (HellaSwag, PIQA, Winogrande, etc.), arithmetic/MATH, advanced knowledge/MMMLU, and related zero/five-shot tables and figures. License named only as 'permissive license' (no Apache/MIT string). No model release/launch date in the text (arxiv stamp is paper date; abstract says weights will be made available). Training throughput (117 teraFLOPS/GPU) and energy (MWh) are stated but not total training FLOPs, so trainingCompute is not_stated. Languages not explicitly claimed for the model.
